lines.zh: 我在地牢的石廊里走一圈。
lines.en: I make my round along the dungeon corridor.
The keys on my belt clink the whole way.

lines.zh: 这层的门我都要看一遍。
lines.en: I check every door on this floor.

lines.zh: 地砖缝里有风，我踩得很稳。
lines.en: Wind seeps between the tiles; I step carefully.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在地牢里太长。
lines.en: My footsteps stretch too long in this dungeon.
At the iron door, I pause a moment.
The torches need changing; I have noted it.
I walk along the wall, avoiding the puddles.
I still have to visit the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 箱子的位置我闭眼也知道。
lines.en: I know the chests' places with my eyes shut.
I do not hurry; this dungeon is long.
Moss on the steps, better be careful.
One full round before I trust the stock.

lines.zh: 我手里拿着账，边走边翻。
lines.en: I walk with the ledger open in my hands.

lines.zh: 没人的时候，我清点货物。
lines.en: With no one about, I count the goods.

lines.zh: 货架空了一格，得等补上。
lines.en: One shelf is empty; I must wait for restock.
I sit on a crate and polish the keys.

lines.zh: 地牢的交易不常有客人。
lines.en: Trade in a dungeon rarely brings guests.
I cross out a line in the ledger.
Counting coins is daily work for me.
That brick by the door has come loose again.
I drink; the water tastes of stone.
Restocking takes time; I cannot rush it.
The dripping water makes me drowsy.
I can recite my whole trade list.
Few come here, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的放在最里面。
lines.en: The priciest goods sit at the very back.
I am waiting for the next shipment.

lines.zh: 你站在栏外，是要买东西吗？
lines.en: You stand at the bars, are you here to buy?

lines.zh: 先把武器收起来，再谈价。
lines.en: Put the weapon away first, then we talk price.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，也看你的口袋。
lines.en: I look at your hands and at your pockets.

lines.zh: 地牢里的客人，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every guest in this dungeon.

lines.zh: 你的靴子带泥，从下面来的？
lines.en: Mud on your boots, did you come from below?

lines.zh: 三十点生命，我够撑到你出价。
lines.en: Thirty health is enough to hear your offer.
Your eyes keep drifting to that chest.

lines.zh: 我不问你来历，只问买卖。
lines.en: I ask not where you come from, only what you trade.

lines.zh: 把你手上的东西亮出来。
lines.en: Hold up what you have in your hand.

lines.zh: 你看起来像付得起的人。
lines.en: You look like someone who can pay.
Behind these doors is my stock.

lines.zh: 你迟疑的样子，我见过很多。
lines.en: I have seen many who hesitate like you.
Do not peer inside; speak with me first.

lines.zh: 我们的交易很干净，放心。
lines.en: Our trade is clean; set your mind at ease.

lines.zh: 你的灯笼照到我的货架了
lines.en: Your lantern is lighting up my shelves.

lines.zh: 别踩那条线，那是我的地界
lines.en: Do not cross that line; that is my boundary.

lines.zh: 打伤守门人，谁给你换货？
lines.en: Wound the keeper, and who will trade with you?
I retreat behind the counter.

lines.zh: 这一下打掉了我的账本。
lines.en: That blow knocked my ledger away.

lines.zh: 十五颗心，够我算完这笔。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts is time enough to finish this deal.
You cut my offer short.
It hurts, but the price stands.
I clutch my side; the keys are still mine.
This wound costs me a day's profit.

lines.zh: 地牢的墙替我挡了一下。
lines.en: The dungeon wall took part of that hit.
I put it in the ledger: you owe this.
That piece in your hand, I can afford it.
Let me judge the quality; no hurry.

lines.zh: 这东西我上次收过一件。
lines.en: I took in one of these before.

lines.zh: 你把袋子打开，我闻见铜味。
lines.en: Open the bag; I smell copper.
Before pricing, let me feel it.
I have been short of this for a long while.

lines.zh: 你的东西好，我眼睛亮了。
lines.en: Your goods are good; my eyes light up.

lines.zh: 放下吧，我会给个公道价。
lines.en: Set it down; I will give a fair price.
I am not greedy, but I do not lose.
I can resell this one quickly.
Do not bump the cabinet; the glass will break.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，钥匙差点掉了。
lines.en: You knocked into me and my keys nearly fell.
The dungeon path is narrow; walk slower.

lines.zh: 我们挤在门口，谁也别急。
lines.en: We are jammed in the doorway; let us both wait.
Your boot is on my ledger page.
Stop pushing; the shelf is going over.

lines.zh: 撞一下没关系，货不能碰。
lines.en: Bumping me is fine; the goods are not.
I step aside; you may pass.

lines.zh: 这一撞把灰都拍下来了。
lines.en: That collision knocked the dust loose.

lines.zh: 你的肩甲撞疼我的锁骨。
lines.en: Your pauldron raps my collarbone hard.
She keeps the books; I keep the keys.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守夜，一人半夜。
lines.en: We split the night watch in half.
Her prices are surer than mine.

lines.zh: 两个守门人，地牢才不会乱。
lines.en: Two keepers are what keeps a dungeon orderly.

lines.zh: 补货的单子我们一起核。
lines.en: We check the restock list together.
She is a floor below; I stay here.

lines.zh: 我们说话很短，都在算账。
lines.en: We speak briefly; both of us are counting.
She never lets me take a bad deal.
One ring of keys, shared between two.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候，我们靠着坐。
lines.en: When the lamps go out, we sit close.
I pick the copper coin off the floor.
Goods dropped at the door count as mine.

lines.zh: 我弯腰拾起你掉的扣子。
lines.en: I bend and pick up the button you dropped.
I will hold on to this ring for now.
Everything I find goes into the book.
That dagger on the floor goes on the shelf.
I do not collect rubbish, only merchandise.

lines.zh: 你掉的这个，值两个银币。
lines.en: What you dropped is worth two silver.
As I bend down, I keep watching you.
I wipe it clean so it will sell.
The door sounded; a customer is here.
I look up and check your hands first.
The footsteps have stopped at my counter.

lines.zh: 这一层今天第一位客人。
lines.en: The first customer on this floor today.

lines.zh: 门一响，我就知道有生意。
lines.en: The door creaks, and I smell a deal.
I hear coins knocking in your bag.
Come in; the door is not locked.

lines.zh: 我认得这种迟疑的脚步。
lines.en: I know that hesitating kind of footstep.
You are looking at goods; I am looking at you.
That pillar will not hide your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，怕你顺手拿东西。
lines.en: I watch you in case something slips into your pocket.
Your hand is much too near the shelf.

lines.zh: 走到哪我都看着，别介意。
lines.en: I watch wherever you go; do not take offense.
You circle behind; I circle as well.
This side of the counter is mine.

lines.zh: 你付钱之前，货不算你的。
lines.en: Until you pay, the goods are not yours.
I watch your companion as well as you.
Leave that lock alone; I am counting.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我都跟半步。
lines.en: Every step you take, I take half of one.
Stand under the lamp so I can see.
I have struck plenty of thieves before.
A ring of keys hits hard enough.
You swung first; remember that.

lines.zh: 这一下只是提醒你规矩。
lines.en: This one is only a reminder of the rules.
Fifteen hearts, and I am still standing.
Do not make me shut the gate.
I may lose this fight, but I will fight.
You smashed my counter.

lines.zh: 这一棍打在你的护腕上。
lines.en: This club lands on your bracer.
When this is over, you still pay full price.

lines.zh: 地牢开门，我就在柜台后。
lines.en: The dungeon opens, and I am behind the counter.

lines.zh: 火把点起来，我开始营业。
lines.en: The torches are lit; I open for business.

lines.zh: 我从里屋出来，带着账本。
lines.en: I come out of the back room with the ledger.

lines.zh: 这层地牢总得有人看着。
lines.en: Someone has to keep watch on this floor.
The shelves are set; I sit and wait.

lines.zh: 钥匙挂在钉子上，我来了。
lines.en: The keys hang on the nail; I have arrived.
The hinge creaks once, and I look up.
The deeper the dungeon, the thinner the trade.
I turn the sign; the shop is open.

lines.zh: 新的守门人接手这一层。
lines.en: A new keeper takes over this floor.
Keep the fire off my stock; burn me instead.
I fall down the steps, pages scattering.
The water reaches my chest; the goods will spoil.
The blast tipped over half the shelf.

lines.zh: 箭钉在柜台上，离我一手。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in the counter, a hand from me.

lines.zh: 这魔法让我的钥匙发烫。
lines.en: This magic makes my keys burn hot.
I am hungry, and the accounts still need doing.
Lightning runs in along the iron door.
There is no counter to keep in the void.
